name: Analyze AI Brand Voice
description: Analyzes content for ai brand voice consistency using AI.
project_description: Analyze AI Brand Voice is a plugin for the Analyze content-analysis framework that scores how well each content entity aligns with a site's brand voice. An administrator writes free-text brand voice guidelines (for example "Professional yet approachable, technically accurate but accessible"); the module renders the entity to plain text, sends it together with those guidelines to a chat-capable provider configured in the AI module, and asks for a single JSON score between -1.0 (completely off-brand) and +1.0 (perfect alignment). The score is shown as a gauge on the entity's Analyze tab and stored in a dedicated results table so repeat views are instant. Results are keyed by a SHA-256 content hash and an MD5 configuration hash, so a score is reused only while both the content and the guidelines are unchanged and is invalidated automatically on entity update/delete or a guidelines change. A bundled Views report at admin/reports/brand-voice-analysis lists scores across all content with Views Color Scales colour coding, and analysis can be run in bulk through the Analyze module's batch system (drush analyze:batch --analyzers=analyze_ai_brand_voice_analyzer). It is part of the DXPR Analyze suite and, when the CKEditor AI Agent module is present, can inherit its brand voice setting as a default.
